counterfactual_text: The first domino tips, and the last domino lies down while every middle domino remains upright.
positive_text: The first domino tips into the second, and each visible contact propagates the fall down the row in order.
semantic_text: A row of upright wooden dominoes falls in sequence after the first domino is pushed. Required visible entities: one row of wooden dominoes; flat support surface. At the beginning: all dominoes: upright, intact, and arranged in one ordered row; first domino: upright and visible at an accessible row end. Required state changes: domino pose: upright to fallen; fall progress: first domino to successive dominoes; contact front: propagates along the row. These event variables are allowed to change: individual domino pose; contact-propagation position; number of fallen dominoes over time. Preserve throughout: static camera; flat support surface; wooden domino identity and row order; one row of wooden dominoes; the same domino order; the same flat support surface.
